text: No. Do not retry or replay it. failed_after_tool_call is an HTTP 424: a failure after an MCP tool or moss_search call had already run, and an MCP tool may have changed data (e.g. written or sent something), so replaying could repeat the side effect. The 424 carries x-should-retry: false, so the Moss SDKs (which by default retry 2 times on connection failures, 408, 409, 429 and 5xx) and the OpenAI SDKs do not retry it either. If you call the endpoint directly, follow the same rule. Instead, check what the tool did, and when reporting a problem include the X-Moss-Request-Id header. (Contrast: 429 rate_limit_exceeded / mcp_loops_busy, wait for Retry-After and retry; 502/503, retry with backoff.)
